# Tests a macOS CI run may skip, as Class.method. scripts/check-xctest-skips.py
# fails test-fast and gpu-parity when any other test is skipped, or when the
# XCTest summary counts more skips than this file lists.
#
# Every entry is gated on an environment variable that ordinary CI runs do not set.
# A test that skips because a kernel did not compile, a render returned nil or a
# scanned function was renamed is NOT environment-gated and does not belong here.

# LUMEN_RAW_CORPUS: set only by raw-corpus.yml (RawCorpusTests.corpus()).
RawCorpusTests.testEveryFileEitherDecodesCleanlyOrRefusesCleanly
RawCorpusTests.testDeliveredDimensionsArePlausibleAgainstTheFilesOwnEXIF
RawCorpusTests.testAPortraitFrameComesOutPortrait
RawCorpusTests.testTheRenderAgreesWithTheCamerasOwnPreview
RawCorpusTests.testTheRenderIsNeitherBlankNorPoisoned
RawCorpusTests.testTheMostNeutralPatchInEachFrameIsNeutral
RawCorpusTests.testAMonochromeSensorProducesNoColour
RawCorpusTests.testMonochromeDecodeOptionSweep
RawCorpusTests.testAnExportReopensWithTheDimensionsItClaims
RawCorpusTests.testATruncatedFileIsRefusedRatherThanHalfDecoded
RawCorpusTests.testTheMetadataReaderGetsRealFilesRight
RawCorpusTests.testTheDecoderVersionPinIsPresentAndStable

# LUMEN_AUDIT_RAW_DIR: set only by raw-corpus.yml (AuditRawAccuracyTests.fixtures()).
AuditRawAccuracyTests.testUnpinnedSourceUsesTheDecoderAppleSelectedForTheFile
AuditRawAccuracyTests.testNativeDimensionsDoNotDependOnDecoderScaleDraftOrCache
AuditRawAccuracyTests.testExplicitRaw9PreviewAndCachePixelsAgreeWithIndependentDecode
AuditRawAccuracyTests.testFirstNativeRaw9DecodeAndCacheHitHaveCorrectPixels
AuditRawAccuracyTests.testExplicitPinsSurviveSwitchesAndUnsupportedPinUsesDefault

# LUMEN_BENCH=1: opt-in benchmarks.
SpeedBenchTests.testInteractiveCPUPath
InteractiveCostBenchTests.testDecomposeOneSliderTick
InteractiveCostBenchTests.testCatalogQueriesOnATwentyThousandPhotoRoll

# LUMEN_APP_BENCH=1: opt-in benchmark.
GeneratedWorkflowCostTests.testGeneratedLargeRollBookkeepingLatencyAndMemory

# LUMEN_PROBE_DUMP_REGISTRY / LUMEN_PROBE_CONTROL: proof-numerics.yml's probes.
ControlProbeHarness.testDumpTheRegistry
ControlProbeHarness.testProbeOneControl
